spans.s: kṛś-ānna, ‘minor food’; cf. kṛśānna-mūlya which is the money to meet expenses of light food (Select Inscriptions, p. 159). See mukh-āhāra.

kṛṣṇala (IA 26), same as rati or guñjā. One kṛṣṇala is regarded by the Kṛtyakalpataru (Vyavahāra-kāṇḍa, ed. K. V. Rangaswami Aiyangar, p. 125) as equal to three guñjās or raktikās apparently through confusion.
kṛṣṇala , same as rati or guñjā (about 1(3/4) grains); regarded as equal to 3 ratis by the Kṛtyakalpataru which seems to confuse rati with yava.
kṛṣṇarāja-rūpaka (EI 30), name of a silver coin issues by the Kalacuri king Kṛṣṇarāja.
kṛṣṇarāja-rūpaka , ‘rūpaka issued by Kṛṣṇarāja (Kalacuri Kṛṣṇa, sixth century A. D.)’; see rūpaka.
